name: GradientEditor
summary: Edits a gradient's colour stops on a bar painted with the gradient itself: drag a stop to move it, click the bar to add one with the colour already there, drag a stop off the bar or press Delete to remove it (two always remain). The selected stop's colour opens the ColourPicker (Enter on a stop too); its position takes an exact number. Flip and Distribute evenly rearrange every stop. Not for one colour (use ColourField) or for shares of a whole (use AllocationSlider).
a11y: A `group` named by the label. Each stop is a `slider` (position 0–100 %) whose `aria-valuetext` says its position and colour ("30 %, #3366ff"); Tab order follows the list, not the position. Add stop is a button, so adding never needs a pointer. Changes are announced politely ("Stop added at 50 %").

keys.action: move the stop 1 %; Shift + arrows or Page Up / Page Down: 10 %; Home / End: to 0 % or 100 %
remove the stop (not when only two remain); Enter: open its colour picker

props.name: label
props.description: What the gradient is for, e.g. "Header background". Shown above the bar; names the group.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new stops on every move, colour change, addition or removal.

props.name: onChangeEnd
props.description: Called once when a drag or key press ends, or a stop is added, removed or recoloured: save here.

props.name: description
props.description: One line under the editor that helps.
